text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of a U-Turn prohibition on Brookmill Boulevard, between Bridletowne Circle and La Peer Boulevard. The prohibition will reduce conflicts and improve safety along this section of Brookmill Boulevard which is a collector roadway in the vicinity of Brookmill Junior Public School. There is currently no such prohibition in effect.
Item SC30.11 was withdrawn from the agenda of the Scarborough Community Council.
